From: Gina Morales <gina.morales@acme-analytics.com>
To: irene_choi@redwood.com
Date: 2025-11-20T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: SOC 2 Type II report request and audit period question

Hi Irene,

Quick note from Acme's compliance team — we're preparing to complete our vendor assurance review and need your SOC 2 Type II documentation. Can you confirm whether Redwood has a Type II report covering the period Apr 1, 2024 — Mar 31, 2025 (or otherwise the most recent 12-month period you can share)? If the report period doesn't include the dates we're assessing, would you be able to provide a short bridge letter that states the control environment hasn't materially changed since the report period?

We typically ask for: the full report (PDF), a bridge letter (if applicable), a short summary of control coverage (for procurement), and guidance on secure transfer (SFTP, presigned Drive links, or secure SharePoint).

Target timeline: would it be possible to share by end of next week (Nov 27)? If not, let us know a realistic ETA. Also, please confirm any telemetry/log extracts or sampling (e.g., authentication logs, retention policy samples) you can include, and whether redaction is acceptable for user-identifying data.

Thanks — and copying our intake mailbox for tracking.

Best,
Gina Morales
Senior Compliance Manager
Acme Analytics
compliance@acme-analytics.com

From: irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>

Cc: naomi_feldman@redwood.com, connor_obrien@redwood.com
Date: 2025-11-20T13:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II report request and audit period question

Hi Gina — thanks for the clear ask. Short answers up front: yes, we have a SOC 2 Type II report that covers the period 2024-04-01 to 2025-03-31, and we can provide a bridge letter if you need confirmation that controls remain in place through your assessment window.

What we can share by Nov 27 (or earlier if you prefer):
- SOC 2 Type II report (PDF)
- A one-page control coverage summary (PDF)
- A bridge letter template (DOCX) we can sign and return once you confirm the exact wording you need
- Redacted sample telemetry extracts for authentication and retention (CSV samples)

Attachments I'm including for your review: redwood_soc2_summary.pdf (high-level coverage), bridge_letter_template.docx (editable template), transfer_instructions.txt (preferred transfer options and encryption notes). We'll redact PII by default; please specify if you need identified samples.

Quick guidance on transfer: presigned Drive links are fine for the report and summary; for telemetry extracts we prefer encrypted SFTP or an encrypted presigned S3 link. The attachment 'transfer_instructions.txt' lists a checklist and our SFTP host details.

One-line reply templates you can reuse on your side (feel free):
- "Received — we'll review the SOC 2 report and bridge letter and follow up if we need samples or clarifications."
- "Presigned Drive link accepted; we'll download and confirm receipt within 2 business days."

If you confirm the bridge letter language, we'll sign and return a PDF (and can have the signed letter to you within 48 hours of confirmation).

CCing Naomi (security operations) and Connor (trust & compliance) so they can prep the telemetry extracts and handle the transfer.

Best,
Irene Choi
Head of Trust & Compliance
Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood_soc2_summary.pdf; bridge_letter_template.docx; transfer_instructions.txt

Hi Irene — thanks for the fast reply and the templates, that's helpful. A couple of clarifications before you send:

1) We do want the bridge letter with wording to confirm there have been no material control changes since the report period — your template looks fine, we'll send a short edit if needed.
2) For telemetry, we only need limited extracts (auth success/failure by source IP for a 2-week sample plus a retention-policy snapshot). Redaction is fine — prefer hashed user identifiers rather than cleartext.
3) Presigned Drive links are okay for the PDFs; for CSV extracts we'd prefer an encrypted presigned S3 link. Can you confirm if Redwood will provide the S3 presigned link and whether it will expire after 7 days?

We also have a brief internal procurement checklist; if you can include a single-line control coverage summary (one para) that helps expedite signoff.

If you can confirm S3 presigned link availability and provide the signed bridge letter and files by Nov 27, that will keep us on track for our audit window.

Thanks — attaching our intake consent form for your records (Acme_transfer_consent_form.pdf).

Best,
Gina

Attachment: Acme_transfer_consent_form.pdf
